title: Project name
description: Shown in the project list and Mesh2HRTF metadata. Changing it does not rename the folder.

title: Left ear
description: Input mesh for the left ear. You can use one ear or both.

title: Right ear
description: Input mesh for the right ear. You can use one ear or both.

title: Save location
description: Project folder for settings, copied inputs, intermediate files, simulations, and HRTFs. Referenced inputs stay in their original locations.

title: Use Mesh2PPM
description: Predict a PPM (parametric pinna model) mesh before preprocessing. Otherwise, use the selected ear mesh.

title: Model
description: Choose a pretrained model by number of views. Default: 3 views.

title: Evaluation grid
description: Directions where the sound field is evaluated. Leave empty to use the bundled 91-direction ARI grid.

title: Ear distance from head center
description: Move both ears inward or outward by the same amount; head size follows. Reference: about 75 mm per side, based on a study of 21 adults.

title: Ear-to-ear radius scale
description: Multiplies the head radius measured from the ear meshes. Default: 1.01.

title: Front-to-back scale
description: Front-to-back head size relative to the ear-to-ear radius. Default: 1.39.

title: Height scale
description: Head height relative to the ear-to-ear radius. Default: 1.5.

title: Head taper (%)
description: Controls how head width changes with height. At +100%, the width scale factor increases by 0.01 per millimetre above the ear axis and decreases by 0.01 per millimetre below it, before height scaling. Positive values widen the top and narrow the bottom; negative values reverse this. Default: 0%.

title: Min frequency
description: Lower limit of the simulated frequency range, in Hz.

title: Max frequency
description: Upper limit of the simulated frequency range, in Hz.

title: Frequency steps
description: Number of frequency samples across the range. Minimum: 2; default: 129.

title: Resample HRIRs
description: Resample HRIR (head-related impulse response) SOFA files after simulation. HRTF (head-related transfer function) SOFA files are unchanged. Off by default.

title: SOFA output folder
description: Project subfolder for SOFA (Spatially Oriented Format for Acoustics) files and plots. Leave empty to use HRTF.

title: Sampling rate
description: Target HRIR rate when resampling is on. Use a positive value divisible by 10 Hz. Default: 48,000 Hz.

title: Microphone faces
description: Number of nearby mesh faces defining the microphone region at the ear-canal entrance. Default: 6.

title: Min edge length
description: Smallest graded mesh edge, in mm. Smaller edges preserve more ear detail. Default: 0.5 mm.

title: Max edge length
description: Largest graded mesh edge, in mm, farther from the active ear. Default: 10 mm.

title: Max error
description: Maximum geometric remeshing error, in mm. Default: 0.5 mm.

title: Gamma
description: Grading factor near the active ear-canal entrance. Default: 0.2.

title: Gamma opposite
description: Grading factor near the opposite ear-canal entrance. Default: 0.1.

title: Parallel instances
description: Maximum concurrent NumCalc jobs. More jobs may be faster but use more CPU and memory. Default: 1.

title: CPU limit (%)
description: Scheduler CPU-load threshold for starting another NumCalc job. Default: 90%.

title: Adaptive FMM expansion length
description: Adapt the fast multipole method (FMM) expansion length to cluster geometry. Enabled by default.

title: Apply level offset
description: Apply a fixed broadband gain to generated SOFA files. Directional spectral shape is unchanged.

title: Level offset
description: Broadband gain applied to SOFA files, in dB. Default: −30 dB.

title: Prepare ears from a head scan
description: Crop and prepare selected ears from an aligned head scan. You can edit the prepared meshes before preprocessing.

title: Full-head scan
description: Select an aligned head scan in millimetres. Prepared ears are saved in the project’s Prepared folder.

title: Crop rotation
description: Rotation around Z, in degrees, used for cropping. Aligning the scan in the app sets this to zero. Left ear is +Y, right ear is −Y.

title: Prepare left ear
description: Extract and prepare the left ear from the aligned scan. At least one ear must be selected.

title: Prepare right ear
description: Extract and prepare the right ear from the aligned scan. At least one ear must be selected.

title: Target edge
description: Target remeshing edge length, in mm. Default: 0.75 mm. Holes are closed with Screened Poisson reconstruction.

title: Left crop margin
description: Margin around the left ear crop, in mm. Default: 20 mm.

title: Right crop margin
description: Margin around the right ear crop, in mm. Default: 10 mm.

title: Inner crop limit
description: Inner lateral crop distance before adding the margin, in mm. Default: 30 mm.

title: Outer crop limit
description: Outer lateral crop distance before adding the margin, in mm. Default: 110 mm.

title: Spatial HRTF upsampling
description: Interpolate HRTFs to add source directions while keeping arrival times. Results are saved in Upsampled; the original SOFA files are kept.

title: Subdivision level
description: How many source directions to add. Level 0 adds none. Higher levels take longer and create larger files. Default: 3.

title: Normalize to frontal reference
description: Scale the upsampled set so the frontal (0°, 0°) response is −40 dB. This replaces the level offset. Off by default.

title: MATLAB executable
description: Legacy setting retained for compatibility. Python upsampling does not use MATLAB.

title: Mesh2PPM
description: Predict a parametric pinna model (PPM) from each ear mesh and use it for simulation setup.

title: Manual PPM fitting
description: Fit a parametric pinna model to each ear mesh by hand and use the saved fit for simulation setup.

title: No ear model
description: Use the ear meshes as they are, without a parametric model.

title: Default project location
description: New projects receive a unique subfolder here. Leave this unset to use Projects inside the active app profile; existing projects keep their save locations.

title: Input files
description: Copy into project keeps a separate copy of each input in the project folder. Reference original files uses their current locations, so those files must remain available and unchanged. This choice applies to new projects.

title: Default input source
description: Choose separate ear meshes or a full-head scan for new projects. Full-head scans must be aligned and cropped into ear meshes before simulation preparation.

title: Default ear modelling method
description: Mesh2PPM predicts a parametric ear mesh automatically; Manual PPM fitting lets you fit and save the model yourself. No ear model uses the ear meshes directly. Each project can change this choice later.

title: Ears to prepare
description: Choose which ears to extract from a full-head scan by default. This does not select input files and does not affect projects using individual ear meshes.

title: Require ear review
description: Pause after extracting ears from a full-head scan so you can inspect and accept or edit each prepared ear before continuing. Enable this for new projects that should always include a manual review.

title: Auditory Modeling Toolbox folder
description: Legacy setting retained for compatibility. Python upsampling does not use AMT.

title: Ear canal closure
description: How the ear canal opening is capped before simulation. Direct triangulates the opening as it is, the original method. Interpolated triangulates the opening from the side and blends its depth from the edge, which gives a smoother cap for uneven openings. Default: Direct.

title: Head opening
description: Shape of the opening cut into the dummy head where the ear is attached. Ellipse sizes an ellipse from the ear's extent. Bounding box removes the head surface inside the ear's side-view outline box plus a margin. Ear outline follows the ear's own outer edge. Default: Ellipse.

title: Opening clearance
description: Scales the ellipse around the ear when the head opening is an ellipse. Larger values leave more room between the ear edge and the head. Default: 1.3.

title: Opening margin
description: Extra distance around the ear's outline box when the head opening is a bounding box, in millimetres. Default: 10 mm.

title: Seam smoothing passes
description: Number of smoothing passes over the seam where the ear joins the head. 0 leaves the seam unsmoothed. Default: 5.

title: Seam smoothing strength
description: How far each smoothing pass moves the seam vertices, from 0 (none) to 1. Default: 0.35.

title: Torso modelling
description: Off simulates the head only. Geometric adds a neck and upper torso to the simulation mesh; Acoustic keeps the head-only mesh and adds modelled torso reflection and shadow to the exported HRIRs. Acoustic mode checks and extends the simulation grid during Simulation setup, then removes helper directions during SOFA export.

publications.title: Algazi et al. (2001): The CIPIC HRTF Database

title: Torso width
description: Maximum left-to-right width of the capped half-ellipsoid. Default: 459.00 mm. Neck diameter is calculated as 77% of the head width before taper.

publications.title: Algazi et al. (2001): The CIPIC HRTF Database

title: Torso depth
description: Maximum front-to-back depth of the capped half-ellipsoid. Default: 238.68 mm.

publications.title: Algazi et al. (2001): The CIPIC HRTF Database

title: Torso height
description: Height from the flat bottom to the top of the torso. Default: 134.20 mm. The top stays 139.60 mm below the ear axis using fixed CIPIC head and neck proportions; the bottom and connecting neck are positioned automatically.

publications.title: Algazi et al. (2001): The CIPIC HRTF Database

title: Reflection gain
description: Amplitude gain of the added torso reflection before optional reflection-mix normalization. Changing this requires SOFA export again, while valid simulation results can be reused.

title: Minimum elevation
description: Lowest source elevation receiving the reflection model. Leave blank to include every source direction. Changing this may require a different simulation grid and a new Simulation setup.

title: Maximum angular gap
description: Largest permitted angular gap between a reflection query and a simulated direction. Simulation setup adds helper directions when needed; the exported SOFA retains only the requested grid.

title: Grid symmetry
description: Automatic preserves symmetry when the requested grid is symmetric. Require symmetry rejects an asymmetric grid; Off does not request symmetric helper directions.

title: Delay model
description: Select the torso-reflection delay calculation. Reijniers uses the model source distance below. This affects SOFA export, not the simulated mesh.

title: Model source distance
description: Source distance in metres used by the Reijniers delay model. This does not change the evaluation grid radius or NumCalc setup.

title: HRIR interpolation
description: Peak-aligned interpolation combines nearby HRIRs after aligning their peaks. Nearest direction uses the closest simulated HRIR.

title: Missing reflection coverage
description: Stop export reports missing reflection coverage as an error. Skip uncovered directions omits the reflection contribution where suitable data is unavailable.

title: Apply torso shadow
description: Apply the acoustic model’s direction-dependent shadow filter together with the reflection. This affects SOFA export only.

title: Normalize reflection mix
description: Normalize the combined direct and reflected contribution using the model’s reflection-mix normalization. This is separate from level offset and frontal-reference normalization.
